title: Width of the transformed formula
statement: For every CNF formula $\varphi$ over variables indexed by $\mathbb{N}$ and every cursor $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the formula produced by the threaded clause transform of $\varphi$ at $n$ has width at most three.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a CNF formula over natural-number variables
replaced:
For every CNF formula $\varphi$ and cursor $n$, the formula produced by the
threaded clause transform of $\varphi$ at $n$ has width at most three.
